fields.name: keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: Combined with the metadata sheet's meta-keywords as its keyword-action column says: default (or empty), these win; override, the sheet's win; merge, both, these first.

fields.name: page-type
fields.label: Page Type
fields.description: The Site Global Template of the page (layout and template code). The metadata sheet's sheet-page-type column overrides it.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: The header (nav) page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Navigation (or the metadata sheet's nav column), else the locale's references/nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: The footer page of this page and, unless they set their own, its child pages. Empty: the nearest parent page's Footer (or the metadata sheet's footer column), else the locale's references/footer.

fields.name: error-page
fields.label: 404 Page
fields.description: The page shown when a page below this one isn't found. Empty: the nearest parent page's 404 Page (or the metadata sheet's error-page column), else the locale's error-pages/404.

fields.name: hide-header
fields.label: Hide Header
fields.description: Shows this page without the header (logo bar, menu and header Conversation Canvas); the page starts at the top. This page only, not its child pages (metadata sheet column hide-header).

fields.name: hide-footer
fields.label: Hide Footer
fields.description: Shows this page without the footer (footer Conversation Canvas, copyright, links and social links). This page only, not its child pages (metadata sheet column hide-footer).

fields.name: hide-canvas
fields.label: Hide Conversation Canvas
fields.description: Hides every Conversation Canvas on this page: the header's, the footer's and the page's own (faded in the editor, as with Hide block). This page only, not its child pages (metadata sheet column hide-canvas).
